text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a remote region of the continent of
Umanest looms the castle of
the demon
lord.

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was tasty! Nothing beats ruining
an entire civilization for a
bowl of risotto!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Anyways... what am I going to do about El
and Grass? I would've been
unstoppable if
they hadn't showed up.

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
I better get prepared before they barge
their way into my castle. Hey,
Demon
General A! Demon General B!

text_block_list.name: Demon Generals
text_block_list.text:
How can we serve you, your demonic
lordship?

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text: It's Gold Ship, got it? The Uma Lord Gold Ship!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Now listen up—go and give that brawler El
and her cleric Grass a
good spanking and
send 'em packing!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see. The "lordship" that demon officer
revered so much... is actually
Gold Ship! If
she's the cause of this recent trouble, we'll
need to take
her out as soon as possible.
Ohohoho! I'm not about to let that happen!

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
You're going to meet your end right here,
right now. As the Uma
Lord's first-rate
general, I, Madam King, will make sure of
it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Madam... King? A demon modeled after
King Halo, I gather.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
An evil King... let's just ignore her. She'll
probably fall to ruin all on
her own.

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text: How rude! I will not fall to ruin in any way!

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
I should warn you though, I'm not the only
general here to thwart your
little plans.
Take a look up at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Where did those dark clouds come from all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Some demons are able to
manipulate the weather to their
liking. It
just so happens that my fellow general is
one such demon!

text_block_list.name: Bloody Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I'm the dark druid, Bloody Sky.
The peaceful Sky you love is
about to
disappear forever!

text_block_list.name: Bloody Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come, crimson clouds! Bathe this world in
red!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Th-the sky's startin' to look all dark and
gloomy! Oh no...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Be careful, El! We don't know what kind of
magic they'll cast next!

text_block_list.name: Bloody Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Bloody Sky
text_block_list.text:
I mean, changing the sky's color is pretty
much the extent of my
abilities.

text_block_list.name: Bloody Sky
text_block_list.text:
But still, it really set the mood, huh? You
can take it from here, King!

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Passing the buck before the deed is
done again? Why are you
always... Oh...
Ahem... Where were we?

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
Now then, El. Allow me to welcome you to
my wonderful realm of
illusion and magic.
Welcome to The King's World!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where am I?

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
As you can surely see, this is the ballroom
of my lordship's royal
palace. In this arena,
we ladies will compete not by combat, but

through dance.

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
So, would you care to dance, El? Surely,
you know a friendly social
dance or two?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A, a what?! I-I mean, I know a dance, sure...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Check this out! Mambo! A-cha-cha-cha!
Cha-cha-cha-cha! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
What? Your moves are terrible. It's like
watching a snow monkey try
to dance. You
have the nerve to constantly boast about
being the
world's strongest, but by the
looks of it...

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text: You're the world's weakest dancer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gahhhh! The world's... weakest?!

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You are the world's absolute weakest.
Weakest, weakest,
weakest...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The weakest, the weakest... I give up... I
can't bounce back from
this...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Pull yourself together, El! Don't let those
illusions sway you!

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! With El down, we now only have
the cleric to deal with.
You won't stand a
chance against us.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes... You have a point. Unlike El, I can't
fight with my fists. All I can
do is...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Brighten up this cloudy sky.

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Where did that surge in magical
power come from? Grass, what
are you up
to?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If magic shrouds the world in darkness,
then as a cleric, it is my duty
to clear that
darkness away—by the thunderous light of
the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El wasn't the only one growing stronger as
we fought battle after
battle to get here!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Divine judgment, come down and cleanse
this world! Ninth-level
cleric spell—Angelic
Bolt!

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text:
Huhhh?! The bloodstained clouds and my
ballroom both vanished in a
blink of an
eye!

text_block_list.name: Madam King
text_block_list.text: Retreat, Sky! We have to retreat!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass... That was amazin'! You finally
mastered Angelic Bolt!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
With that spell under your belt, defeatin'
the Uma Lord will be a
piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Fantasy incarnate... shall look down upon
this world from the
heavens. With innate,
thunderous power..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué? Somethin' the matter?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing. Now then, shall we be
off? We've got a castle to
storm!
